title: Nonparabolic holonomy of trees of crossing circles
status: Draft; original marked representations and positive primitive filling germs, without a quantum asymptotic or preferred-longitude formula
imports: The original ordered cut and positive angular octahedra from Positive octahedra and primitive fillings for trees of crossing circles, Proposition 2.1 and Lemma 3.1; its Theorems 1.1 and 7.1 supply the geometric anchors for the stated quantitative applications.
The physical positive odd meridian convention from Marked geometry of strict Conway compositions, Section 5, equations (5.1)–(5.2). No global quantum estimate is imported.

The actual cusp-side rows and normal-flow intersection identity from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Section 7.1, equations (7.1)–(7.2). The edge rank, polarized Jacobian and shape/representation inverse are proved here.

Full local matrices, ordered conjugacies, global selected flags and primitive slope words are proved in this paper. A separately constructed branch must have the same actual positive filled anchor before its identification with the geometric germ.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
